title: metadata-protocol + objectql: an object extension is an authorable item of a writable package — saved and published through the existing doors, registered as 'extend', exported as objectExtensions
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P2, cut 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」, schedule reviewed) · plan of record: ADR-0146 Rollout P2 "N-23a/b/c object extension … Studio add-field (D10)"; cut by the drafting review because two drafters found no server door for the write N-23c makes. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28564

Part of #28236 (P2, child **N-23e**) · governs: ADR-0146 D10 (an extension of a base object is an item of `.custom`), D2 (Studio and code produce the same package, exported and deployed), D3 ("It receives … extensions of the base's objects") · lane: `domain:server` (`packages/metadata-protocol`, `packages/objectql`, `packages/runtime` export; declared minor spec surface: one registry row in `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`) · size: M.

**Why it exists.** D10 says Studio's add-field "writes exactly this: an extension in `.custom`". Today an extension arrives only in a manifest; no door lets a running deployment author one into a writable package, so N-23c would have nothing to call.

**Business reason.** An administrator adds "Region" to HotCRM's Account in Studio. The field must be stored in `hotcrm.custom`, served on every read of the account object, exported with the package so another environment gets it, and withdrawn when the package is. Today only a developer shipping a new package version can add such a field.

**Measured (`35b178bd0a`).**
- The only `'extend'` registration is the manifest loop `objectql/src/engine.ts:8815-8833`: six hand-copied keys into `extDef`, then `registerObject(…, 'extend', priority)`; `registry.ts:3818-3836` refuses `defaultRowScope` and `membershipKeys` there.
- The artifact loader stores a compiled package's `objectExtensions` in the metadata service under the type name `object_extension` (`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts:132`, `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE`), a separate collection beside `object` (`protocol.ts:9120-9145` docblock). It is read for the fold, never written through a door, and `object_extension` has no row in `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` (`metadata-plugin.zod.ts`: no hit).
- The stored-object sync registers a stored `object` row as `'own'` or `'overlay'` (`protocol.ts:17957`, `:28888`; `objectql/src/plugin.ts:1640`); a stored row naming a base's object from another package is an ownership conflict (`registry.ts:2744`), not an extension. `objectql/src/plugin.ts:178-182`: `object_extension` "has no slot of its own".
- Export assembles a manifest from the rows bound to the package (`runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:2424`, `assemblePackageManifest`); whether it would carry an `object_extension` row as `objectExtensions`: not verified (no such row exists yet).
- Withdrawal: `registry.ts:5332#subtractExtenderContributions`; the pair's uninstall is N-14's (#28408, landed). Write scope: `protocol-write-package-scope.ts#resolveWritePackageScope`.

**Wanted.**
1. **The item.** `object_extension` becomes an authorable type: one registry row (`allowRuntimeCreate`, versioned, no overlay); body = `ObjectExtensionSchema` as it stands (N-23a's slot rides in when it lands); stored under the writable package with the target object's name as the row name — one extension per package per target, the body still carrying `extend` and no `name`. Draft, publish, history, rollback and delete go through the doors every item uses; no second door.
2. **Gate at save and publish**, in those doors: the target object exists in the registry and lies inside the writing package's dependency closure (the "declare a dependency" sentence `resolveWritePackageScope` prints); the package is writable; #28564's `__c` judge is asked; the registry's extension refusals (`defaultRowScope`, `membershipKeys`) answer `400` with their sentences instead of a sync-time throw.
3. **Registered as `'extend'`.** On publish the row is registered with the **whole parsed body**, ⛔ not a hand-copied key list, so every schema key reaches `mergeObjectDefinitions`. Every sync that re-reads stored rows (boot, `kernel:ready`, `metadata:reloaded`, the mutation sync) re-registers it the same way; deleting the row withdraws it through `subtractExtenderContributions`; the pair's uninstall withdraws all of them.
4. **Served as a manifest extension is:** by-name, list and layered object reads and `getObjectContributors` show the field with the pair as source; records store values in it (the DDL path the manifest kind takes, unchanged).
5. **Export and round trip.** The pair's `GET /packages/:id/export` carries each row as an `objectExtensions` entry, so the export re-installs through `installPackage` and registers at `engine.ts:8815` with no second code path. The base's export is unchanged.
6. **Contract.** Zod-first registry row; route ledger, SDK and OpenAPI regenerated; `Metadata-protocol: added`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; `scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` stays green.

**Tests.** A writable pair saves and publishes an extension on the base's object: the field is on all three object reads with the pair as source, a record stores a value in it, export carries `objectExtensions`, and re-installing the export into a fresh kernel registers the same field. Refused, leaving no row: target outside the closure, unknown target, read-only package, a `.custom` field without `__c` (N-23b's sentence), `defaultRowScope` on the body. Deleting the row and uninstalling the pair each remove the field from every read. `registry-extension-system-columns.test.ts` and `registry-object-extension-nonenumerated-prop-discard.test.ts` stay green.

**Release safety.** Additive: a new authorable type behind the existing doors; manifest extensions untouched. N-23b in `Blocked-by:` means the first runtime-authored `.custom` extension is already suffix-judged. Until N-23c, nothing in the console writes the type.

**Not here.** The patch slot (#28560). The `__c` judge (#28564). Applying the patch and the patch's target-field check (#28565). Studio add-field (#28575). Structural changes to a base field (D6). Counting extensions per base (N-15, #28411).

**Dedupe.** Searched `object extension studio write`, `objectExtensions runtime authored`, `object_extension metadata type`: only #28236 and closed manifest-side history (#24363, #24182, #28153). No card gives an extension a write door.

Links back: #28236, #28404, #28408, ADR-0146 D2, D3, D10, ADR-0029 D7/D9, ADR-0141 D1.
